name: unsafe
doc: Raw memory access and foreign calls without any checks; importing it needs the `unsafe` capability in the manifest.

items.name: AddrOf
items.doc: AddrOf returns the data word of the `any` value x.
items.summary: AddrOf returns the data word of the `any` value x.

items.name: CString
items.doc: CString copies the NUL-terminated C string at addr.
items.summary: CString copies the NUL-terminated C string at addr.

items.name: CallFunc
items.doc: CallFunc calls the C function at addr with up to 8 integer arguments and returns its integer result.
items.summary: CallFunc calls the C function at addr with up to 8 integer arguments and returns its integer result.

items.name: ReadBytes
items.doc: ReadBytes copies n bytes starting at addr. Nothing is checked.
items.summary: ReadBytes copies n bytes starting at addr.

items.name: ReadFloat
items.signature: func ReadFloat(addr int, size int) float
items.doc: ReadFloat reads a float of size bytes (4 or 8) at addr. Nothing is checked.
items.summary: ReadFloat reads a float of size bytes (4 or 8) at addr.

items.name: ReadInt
items.signature: func ReadInt(addr int, size int) int
items.doc: ReadInt reads a signed integer of size bytes (1, 2, 4, 8) at addr. Nothing is checked.
items.summary: ReadInt reads a signed integer of size bytes (1, 2, 4, 8) at addr.

items.name: ReadUint
items.signature: func ReadUint(addr int, size int) int
items.doc: ReadUint reads an unsigned integer of size bytes at addr. Nothing is checked.
items.summary: ReadUint reads an unsigned integer of size bytes at addr.

items.name: TypeOf
items.doc: TypeOf returns the type word of the `any` value x.
items.summary: TypeOf returns the type word of the `any` value x.

items.name: WriteBytes
items.doc: WriteBytes copies b to addr. Nothing is checked.

items.name: WriteInt
items.signature: func WriteInt(addr int, size int, v int)
items.doc: WriteInt writes v as an integer of size bytes at addr. Nothing is checked.
items.summary: WriteInt writes v as an integer of size bytes at addr.
